sources.title: Village Vanguard / Smoke / Birdland / Jazz Gallery reviews | Exa place listing
sources.text: Amazing experience - strong drinks, friendly service and great music. We didn’t have any food because vegan options were not exciting at all but still had a lovely evening with great cocktails. Would definitely recommend booking this experience in advance and also coming early if you want nice seats! Sat at the bar for Afro Latin Jazz Orchestra. Wonderful and awesome. Had amaretto coffee drinks and cheesecake bc we had already eaten dinner. Dessert chef is amazing, best cheesecake ive ever had. Very fluffy and delicious. Barkeep said desserts were the shining stars of menu. Such a wonderful place with great vibes and tasty food. The live performance by the drummer, pianist, and double bassist was fantastic! I left my clothes there by mistake, and even though they were busy, a kind lady took the time during the performance break to find them for me. I really appreciated her kindness. I’d love to come back again someday. We had an amazing evening at this jazz club! The atmosphere was vibrant yet cozy, with incredible live music that set the perfect tone for the night. The musicians were extremely talented and kept the crowd entertained from start to finish. Dinner was just pretty tasty—we had lasagna and Cajun jambalaya. The service was excellent too: friendly, attentive, and made the whole experience seamless. It’s not easy to find a place that combines great food, top-notch live music, and a welcoming vibe, but this spot does it all. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a fun and memorable night out!

review1: Booking jazz club tickets well in advance and arriving early is the most repeated advice, since the best seats go to those who come first on popular nights.
review2: Live trio performances featuring drums, piano and double bass are praised for their energy and musicianship, delivering memorable shows that justify the cover and the trip to the club.
review3: The musicians come across as extremely talented and skilled at holding a room, keeping the audience engaged and entertained from the first song of the set through the very last.
review4: Service is described as friendly and attentive, with staff keeping drinks and orders moving quietly during the set and helping the whole evening run smoothly from arrival to the final song.
